title: デビュー戦の後に・レースって最高！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While basking in the thrill of racing, she sets her sights on the race that will decide the junior champion…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her goal is decided—as the first major step towards her dream, she locks her crosshairs on the Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes!
